values.note: $5 per vehicle after two; vehicles that do not fit the site's spur park in the day-use area at the extra-vehicle fee. Day use free.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/river-point-campground ('Single Site: $20 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per additional vehicle(s) after two vehicles') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10107638 (notices; 'No fees or reservations are required for day use') + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-07: $20), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10107638 (notice: 'No utility hookups are avaliable.') + recreation.gov catalog (all 27 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, water 'No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Paved spurs, 31-56 ft in the recreation.gov catalogue; 5 sites have river-front access.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10107638 ('The 27 individual RV/Tent sites', 'a paved parking stall', 'This includes 5 sites with river-front access') + recreation.gov catalog (max vehicle length 31-56 ft), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10107638 ('Accessible vault toilets, drinking water and trash receptacles are available throughout the campground'; amenity 'Drinking Water (peak season)') + Forest Service page ('vault toilet', 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov: open the Friday before Memorial Day to the Tuesday after Labor Day, when the gate closes; roads are not plowed.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/river-point-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Open May 22, 2026 - September 8, 2026'; page last updated September 15, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10107638 ('available for reservation the Friday before Memorial Day to the Tuesday after Labor Day, when the campground gate closes for the season'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10107638 ('The 27 individual RV/Tent sites are avaliable for reservation'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16 consecutive nights, maxStay 32 nights each year; catalog: all 27 sites reservable) + Forest Service page ('Make Reservations Here'), read 2026-10-22

note: Lolo NF campground on the west shore of Seeley Lake where it meets the Clearwater River, 3 mi NW of Seeley Lake town on Boy Scout Road. Beside a day-use beach with a roped swimming area; old-growth western larch; heavy use all season. No boat launch. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page + recreation.gov (Forest Service, Seeley Lake RD; reservable): confirmed $20, no hookups, 27 sites, vault toilets, drinking water, recreation.gov booking; max_rig_ft changed 60 -> 56 (rec.gov catalogue); added season May 22 - Sep 8 (2026), 16-night limit.
